review.posthog_relevance: Adds Bitbucket Pipelines ingestion capability, including pipeline step and commit status endpoints, and credential stripping for private container images.
review.reason: The change implements a new Bitbucket Pipelines ingestion capability. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F3.H1 add configuration and descriptions for the new `pipeline_steps` and `commit_statuses` endpoints, enabling ingestion of CI duration and outcome metrics. P1.F2.H4 and P1.F5.H5 modify the resume configuration to support parent-child relationships and credential stripping. P1.F5.H7 adds a test.
